headline: The 1,216,215 three-W33 decompositions form a natural degree-78 refactorization graph with 47,432,385 edges. The group generated by the complete local move libraries fixing the W33 blocks of one frame is Suz projectively and 2.Suz in the 12-dimensional F3 symplectic lift. This is a large six-qutrit Clifford subgroup, but has index 16054507443872541110987520 in Sp(12,3).

move_group.argument: two distinct W33 stabilizers are distinct conjugate maximal subgroups; maximality forces their generated subgroup to be Suz

boundary: The theorem concerns exact finite symplectic/permutation actions. Refactorization moves are Clifford operations in this model and do not by themselves provide non-Clifford magic or physical implementability.
